title: CNNs trained on islet epigenomes predict regulatory variants at type 2 diabetes loci
summary: Convolutional neural networks trained on a broad set of epigenomic features from pancreatic islets were evaluated for predicting regulatory variants. CNN-based metrics converged with genetic fine-mapping and regulatory annotation enrichment, refined association signals at type 2 diabetes loci, and one such signal received experimental validation. The finding rests on the abstract only, and only one locus is validated.
ai_technology: Convolutional neural networks trained on islet epigenomic features to predict variant regulatory effects

evidence.tested: Experimental validation of one prioritized association signal; convergence with fine-mapping.
evidence.unknown: How many loci are truly refined beyond the one tested; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: CNNs predicted regulatory effects of variants and refined candidate causal variants.
